game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Cold Larder, an ice-cellar larder: the hold guard must handle frozen golems while practicing functions. Core idea – Parameter Potion: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions.
theme: Snowy Hold – Cold Larder: an ice-cellar larder
core_gameplay_loop: In Cold Larder, repeat each round: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the potions value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about potions to power up the hold guard and open the beacon fire.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Parameter Potion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Parameter Potion' (Week 6 slot 2), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Cold Larder'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frozen golems in Cold Larder.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
